status: PROPOSED — generated by misaka-palw-gen-ref2 (scripts/gen_proposed_vectors.sh), held equal to kaspa-consensus-core's tensor worker and execution root; the claim's binding is docs/spec/palw/04b-tensor-ir.md §15.13

preimages.hash: H(key, m) = BLAKE2b-512 keyed with the ASCII bytes of key, over m
preimages.tensor_execution_root: job_id ‖ class_id ‖ le64(step_leaf_count) ‖ step_root ‖ output_root — the 64-byte ids and roots, the count as eight little-endian bytes
preimages.job_id: H(key, the job's Borsh bytes) — gen-v1/job_v1.json
preimages.step_root: step-tree.json: the stage roots (one per stage of the pipeline, in order) hashed into the step root; the leaf count is the sum of the stages' leaves
preimages.output_root: output-v1: the output node's elements in the kind's canonical bytes, cut into tiles of the output node's commit tile length (PALW-OUT-3), the tiles' Merkle root bound with borsh(spec) and tile_len
preimages.claim: the worker runs the pipeline over the accepted job (steps and scalars as acceptance maps them, ids and images as given) with the random source keyed by the job's seed at its item index, commits the one step tree and then the output; the job's seed is the canonical seed of its anchor when the class draws randomness and zero otherwise
preimages.stand_ins: every identity of a job (network domain, bond, operator, anchor, nonce, executor key) and every prompt/text hash is a stand-in: BLAKE2b-512 keyed 'misaka-palw/gen-ref2/vector-standin/v1' over '<tag>:<name>'. The ids' hashes are opaque to a claim (the prompt's carriage is the DA's). The artifact root and tokenizer id of a class are stand-ins too.
